title: Close the full strong theorem for equal frictions, including every binary mixture
statement: When every f_ij=f>0, the flux constraints give grad c_i=f sum_{j!=i}(c_i J_j-c_j J_i)=-f J_i. Thus every species obeys c_i,t+b dot grad c_i=(1/f)Delta c_i. Scalar maximum principles preserve the simplex, parabolic regularity gives unique global classical solutions, and positive heat kernels give c_i(t,x)>0 for t>0 whenever mean c_i>=m. The same explicit entropy controller and finite resource bounds give arbitrary requested exponential entropy decay for all N at this equal-friction scope; every two-species mixture lies in it. This is a restricted full positive result, not the arbitrary-friction/N>=4 theorem.
